system.description: Once per non-conflict scene in a populated place, pick up a package (carry up to five; lost only through Surrender), establishing where and/or to whom it goes. On delivery choose: 1 Fabula Point, (level × 10) zenit, or gain/strengthen a Bond with an NPC, location or organization relevant to the delivery.
